name: plaintheory-packages
description: Workspace for the @theplaintheory/* framework packages. Separate from the app: its own install, build and tests.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @theplaintheory/consent && npm run build -w @theplaintheory/react -w @theplaintheory/vue -w @theplaintheory/svelte -w @theplaintheory/angular
scripts.release: npm test && npm publish -w @theplaintheory/consent && npm publish -w @theplaintheory/react -w @theplaintheory/vue -w @theplaintheory/svelte && npm publish ./angular/dist
